<thought>All pairwise resistance measurements are satisfied by a simple series chain connecting the terminals B and X3 through the intermediate nodes N_d3, N_d2, and N_d1. Assigning the four resistors from left (closest to B) to right (closest to X3) gives the values 20 Ω, 15 Ω, 10 Ω, and 5 Ω respectively. This topology matches every provided measurement, so it is the correct description of subnetwork 4.</thought>
